_meta.comment: Cosmetics catalog, newest to oldest. Outfits complete (10) from Kuro announcements via the skins.md research file, 2026-11-06; images are official Kuro showcase art. Accessories and other categories join as their catalogs are completed.

items.availability: In the in-game shop with Version 3.8, from Nov 12, 2026
items.description: A red-carpet deluxe outfit for Hiyuki — an elegant black-and-cream gown with gold detailing, far more luxurious than her usual attire. In the story she wore it while filming a movie with students of Startorch Academy.
items.imageAlt: Official art for Lune Noire, Hiyuki's deluxe outfit — Hiyuki in a black and cream gown on a red carpet beside a black car, photographers behind a rope barrier
items.name: Lune Noire
Peppermint
items.description: Endless sunshine, golden sand beaches, and vibrant hues bursting everywhere—summer’s here! Lynae’s favorite season, hands down! Hm? The heatwave sapped your energy?
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Peppermint — Lynae's deluxe outfit

items.name: Peach Parfait
items.description: The sky’s colors melt into the sea. Splashing waves sparkle in the brilliant summer sun. A bird glides across the boundless blue overhead. A slice of watermelon and a perfectly chilled peach parfait. Just another slow summer day for her.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Peach Parfait — Chisa's deluxe outfit

items.name: Plush Dream
items.description: Outside the window, the late snow blows through an early spring. In that quiet stretch of waiting, the girl slips into a gentle dream.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Plush Dream — Mornye's deluxe outfit

items.name: Perpetual Spark
items.availability: Free — finish Main Quest Chapter III Act III, then claim it at Startorch Academy
items.description: Rover’s uniform from past days at Startorch Academy.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Perpetual Spark — Rover's signature outfit

items.name: Downtown Repose
items.description: Zani off duty — a soft sweater and an easy lean against the railing, a relaxed look far from her usual sharp tailoring.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Downtown Repose — Zani's deluxe outfit

items.name: Laurel Nymph
items.availability: Outfit Store (permanent) — 2,480 Lunite; 1,980 before the Version 2.5 update
items.description: In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—an invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.” Official 2.4 Steam notes list Laurel Nymph before Splashing Summer.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Laurel Nymph — Changli's deluxe outfit

items.name: Splashing Summer
items.availability: Outfit Store (permanent) — 2,480 Lunite; 1,980 before the Version 2.5 update
items.description: Soft satin flows from her body. Droplets on her skin glisten like luxurious gems. As she slips into the water, the Gem ripples across the pool and into your heart.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Splashing Summer — Carlotta's deluxe outfit

items.name: Peach Blossom
items.availability: Outfit Store (permanent) — 3,280 Lunite; 2,680 before the Version 2.1 update
items.description: Jinhsi in spring finery. Kuro’s reveal line for it: “Now that spring returns, who will share it with me?” — the outfit that launched the Premium tier.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Peach Blossom — Jinhsi's premium outfit

items.name: Exorcistic Adjuration
items.availability: Outfit Store — 1,680 Lunite (free during the Version 2.0 spring event)
items.description: Silver hair, piercing red eyes, and monochromatic garments, with a ferocious mask concealing her face — Sanhua’s exorcist look.
items.imageAlt: Official showcase art for Exorcistic Adjuration — Sanhua's signature outfit

items.availability: Shop bundle during Version 3.8; afterwards it becomes a permanent Astrite purchase
items.description: A black choker accessory for Hiyuki with a gold-and-red sakura ornament — an elegant look with a sharp edge beneath it.
items.imageAlt: Official card for Hiyuki's accessory Flaming Sakura — Hiyuki's portrait above the black choker with its gold and red sakura ornament
items.name: Flaming Sakura
